scope: Archived-state native geometry and compiled contact model inspection plus detached Reachy hand CAD screening. No new physical replay or success claim.

source_carry_geometry.definition: Compiled fixture contact distances at archived source states; mj_forward on independent clones. This is geometry, not recorded force ground truth.

native_contact_model.meaning: Several source contact points can carry moments through separated force locations; a configured spin coefficient is inactive at condim=3.

static_search.limitation: The two-point balanced internal-squeeze condition is necessary for that simplified model, not sufficient for a full grasp wrench or dynamic stability. Gravity moment ranking uses unchanged native reference poses, never failed Reachy object trajectories.

missing_fields: Original BiGym 4.0 observed state trajectories for comparison
Whole-path robot IK/fixture admission for detached-hand candidates
simulation_assumptions: Native-state clones are set only for read-only geometry inspection, not physical validation
Positive closest-distance witnesses are used; zero-distance witness points are not treated as reliable normals
Failed runtime/input attempts are retained with retrospective notes; missing original stderr was not fabricated
